heading: Office of Inspector General
lead: There shall be in the Department an Office of Inspector General, established in accordance with chapter 4 of title 5.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 211 of Pub. L. 96–88 was renumbered section 210 and is classified to section 3421 of this title.
Amendments2022—Pub. L. 117–286 substituted “chapter 4 of title 5.” for “the Inspector General Act of 1978.”
